Forecast provided by the Data Science team. It is a multi-variate stream that incorporates both macroeconomic factors and Cisco-internal features during forecasting.

Prediction bias is the systematic deviation between estimated and actual values. It is useful to see if you tend to overestimate (BIAS > 0) or underestimate your predictions (BIAS < 0) for all your items. Formula: (Forecast Booking units - Actual Booking units)/Actual Booking Units.

Forecast accuracy is the degree of difference between the forecasted demand and the actual order booking. In this case, between Forecasted demand and Actual Booked units. At a product level accuracy is calculated using the formula:MAX(0,1-ABSOLUTE(BIAS))
To calculate overall accuracy for 30 products we will calculate weighted accuracy using product cost to make sure high cost product accuracy gets more weightage than low cost product.
